title: Aladdin
tagline: Run the market. Share the plate.
about: A street thief in Agrabah finds a magic lamp and a genie, and tries to win the heart of Princess Jasmine.
cue: Serve the snacks when Aladdin and Jasmine flee the guards through the Agrabah market.
faces: Palace Gardens, Sultan Approved. Run the market. Share the plate.
I. A Whole New World carpet ride.
II. Abu stealing the lamp back.
III. Iago the parrot at Jafar's shoulder.
Wish number one, a snack. Wish number two, another snack. Wish number three, well, ask Jasmine what she wants.
ZA'ATAR FLATBREADS WITH HUMMUS AND LABNEH
Charred za'atar flatbread with hummus and labneh.
Medjool dates filled with almond butter and dipped in dark chocolate.
Lamb shoulder rubbed with cumin and cinnamon, saffron basmati rice.
Crisp filo with pistachio and walnut filling, cut in diamonds.
Butterfly pea flower and mint tea sweetened with honey, chilled.
At table: Rajah the tiger in the palace. Form BF 3. Poster and stills: TMDB.
